properties.name: cpf.security.secret.environment.enabled
properties.description: Enables the read-only exact-name process-environment Secret Provider. Local/test profiles opt in; non-Local runtimes remain fail-closed unless explicitly configured.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.jdbc.command-ttl
properties.description: Retention for durable masking-policy command deduplication records.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.jdbc.maximum-command-records
properties.description: Maximum durable masking-policy command records before fail-closed rejection.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.jdbc.maximum-history
properties.description: Maximum durable masking-policy versions retained by the JDBC provider.
